How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Gujarat University Research Associate/ Teaching Assistant Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 06-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Gujarat University for filling temporary positions in the Department of Labour Welfare.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in Gujarat University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions are Research Associate and Teaching Assistant on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Research Associate / Teaching Assistant posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 06 October 2026 until 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for Gujarat University jobs?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications through email to the designated official email addresses provided by the university.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree with 55% marks in Labour Welfare along with NET/SET/SLET or a Ph.D. degree.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for Research Associate / Teaching Assistant?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 45,000/-.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification released by Gujarat University.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves the shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview process.

faq.question: Q10. Where should candidates send their filled application forms?
faq.answer: Candidates need to send their scanned applications and required documents to [email protected] or [email protected].
